_comment: Asset-class registry for tools/asset-gen. This is the single extension point:
adding an asset class means adding an entry here plus a prompts/<promptFile>,
never a branch in gen.py. Mirrors the engine's own data-drives-the-code rule.
geometry.size is the FINAL on-disk pixel size the engine expects. geometry.cell
and geometry.frames describe grid sheets; the post-processing pipeline slices the
model's output into that grid. 'post' names steps in lib/postprocess.py, applied
styleBible: Retro JRPG pixel art in the RPG Maker 2003 / late-90s SNES-to-PS1 tradition. Chunky legible pixels, hand-placed dithering rather than smooth gradients, a tight limited palette, strong silhouette readability at small size. Dark low-fantasy dungeon-crawler mood: grimy stone, muted earths and desaturated jewel tones, torch-warm highlights against cold shadow. NEVER: modern vector art, cel-shaded anime line art, watercolour, 3D renders, drop shadows, text, labels, watermarks, signatures, UI frames, or borders.

smallBattler.label: Small battler
smallBattler.note: Idle animation strip drawn in the party grid and status rows. presentation/small_battlers.lua reads the [fps=N] token from the FILENAME.

bigBattler.label: Big battler
bigBattler.note: NEW CLASS: the full-size enemy/creature battle sprite, split out from the double-duty 'spriteKey' portrait lookup. Generates and promotes today; the engine does not read assets/bigBattlers yet (see README 'Pending engine wiring').

portrait.label: Portrait (expression sheet)
portrait.note: presentation/ui.lua slices column 0 as the neutral face; the sheet is 5 x 128x192 columns. NPC files conventionally carry the NPC_ prefix.

sprite.label: World sprite (3D billboard)
sprite.note: Drawn as a whole billboard in the raycast viewport (presentation/viewport_3d.lua slices it by column, so it must NOT be a multi-frame sheet). Faces the camera; feet at the bottom edge.

tileset.label: Tileset texture page
tileset.note: 16 seamlessly-tiling 64x64 surface textures, row-major. Wall/floor/ceiling textures sampled by the raycaster: flat head-on, no perspective, no baked lighting.

panorama.label: Panorama / skybox
panorama.note: Scrolled horizontally behind the dungeon view, so it must wrap left-to-right; seam_blend_x cross-fades the wrap edge.

locationArt.label: Location art
locationArt.note: Establishing illustration for a town or dungeon region.

eventArt.label: Event art
eventArt.note: Wide cutscene banner shown above dialogue.

animation.label: Particle / animation sheet
animation.note: Flipbook strip, cells left-to-right, read row-major by the animation player. Tinted at runtime by the track's colour-over-lifetime, so the art is drawn WHITE/GREYSCALE. Final size is cell*frames wide; --cell and --frames override the defaults and are written into the filename tokens.
